regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-narrative resource-led tape: Oil & Gas Producers leading with high durability (0.68), strong breadth (0.786), and elevated crowding (z=1.04), with Gold Miners as the clear challenger. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on this market (gate_helps=true) and 8 of 16 themes are eligible, but the dominant theme is crowded, not cohesive (one_narrative=false, breadth_of_rotation is broad at 0.5), and the tracker's past directional accuracy is weak (dir_accuracy=0.343) so conviction should default low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (rank 2) can close the 0.502 score margin to Oil & Gas Producers and hold above its own 20-day average for five consecutive sessions while breadth rises above 0.35; if instead XEG.TO prints another 60-day high and XGD.TO breadth stays below 0.3, the handoff hypothesis retires for now.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge here and Oil & Gas Producers is eligible and ranked 1 with the highest durability_bar (0.68) and strongest breadth (0.786), which together support staying with the theme rather than exiting early on a shake-out. This is a trend-discipline lean, not a momentum-return call: rank-IC is ~0, so the rank alone is just an attention lens.
theses.dissent: Crowding is true (z=1.04) and the theme is not one-narrative-dominant, so this is a mature, widely-held leader with higher chop risk; a broad rotation (frac=0.5) plus mixed Hurst tag suggests the edge could fade without a durable handoff.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO breaks below its own 50-day average and stays there while XGD.TO makes a new 60-day high before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the clearest challenger (rank 2, margin only 0.502 behind the leader) and is eligible, uncrowded (z=0.2), with a positive score (1.11) and a durability bar (0.48) that is second-highest among eligible themes. As a trend-gate discipline lean, it merits a directional overweight only if it confirms as a handoff from the crowded leader.
theses.dissent: Breadth is thin (0.267) and Hurst tag is mixed, so this is concentrated leadership in a few large names rather than broad participation; an uncrowded challenger can reverse fast and the tracker has no validated rotation-timing edge.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its 20-day average while XEG.TO prints a new 60-day high before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is eligible and has a 'trend' Hurst tag with a decent durability bar (0.59), but its score is only 0.423 (rank 5) and breadth is thin (0.143), so it does not clear the attention lens versus the two clear leaders. With crowding absent and no confirmed handoff signal, there is no trend-discipline reason to lean into it.
theses.dissent: The trend Hurst tag and positive but lower score could mean a slow grind that compounds without overheating, and as a rate-sensitive sector it may catch a bid if the macro backdrop shifts away from resource leadership.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO outperforms XEG.TO and XGD.TO by more than 3% over the next month before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
